purpose: Every measure the team-season evidence layer may emit, with its definition, its denominator, its source, its sample gate and — where it cannot be computed honestly — the exact reason it is blocked. A measure absent from this file cannot be emitted; a measure present here but blocked emits an explicit unavailability state and never a number.

rules.display_only: Nothing in this file may alter a projected margin, total or win probability. Promotion into the model runs through data/factor_registry.json plus a written pre-registration, and is a separate human decision.
rules.naming: A measure id and label may not overclaim. A sack rate is not a pressure rate; a win-loss record is not a line ranking; venue capacity is not crowd noise; a long gain is not a broken assignment. Proxies carry the word proxy.
rules.opponent_adjustment: Only ratings.solve_units adjusts for opponent here. Every other measure is opponent-UNadjusted and says so. A second strength adjustment (an SOS term, a common-opponent difference) would double-count what the ratings already absorbed.
rules.availability: reconstructed_week_granular means the value was derived from a cache with no observation timestamp; its pregame availability is the assumption that everything from week <= W-1 was knowable at week W. Retrospective PREDICTIVE claims from such observations are blocked. See docs/final_score_program/00_contract.md section 3.

measures.label: Rush success rate (created)
measures.definition: share of rush plays meeting the down-and-distance success threshold (1st: 50% of distance, 2nd: 70%, 3rd/4th: 100%), grouped by the team's offence; identical threshold to ratings._success
measures.denominator: rush plays with a parseable down and distance

measures.label: Rush PPA per play (created)
measures.definition: mean CFBD predicted-points-added per rush play, grouped by the team's offence. PPA is CFBD's model output, not an in-house EPA.
measures.denominator: rush plays carrying a non-null ppa
measures.caveat: PPA is a third-party model output. It is not this project's EPA and is not validated here.

measures.label: Rush success rate (allowed)
measures.definition: share of rush plays meeting the down-and-distance success threshold (1st: 50% of distance, 2nd: 70%, 3rd/4th: 100%), grouped by the team's defence; identical threshold to ratings._success
measures.denominator: rush plays with a parseable down and distance

measures.label: Explosive rush rate (created, >=12 yds)
measures.definition: share of rush plays gaining at least 12 yards, grouped by the team's offence. A yardage threshold and nothing more.
measures.denominator: rush plays with a recorded yards_gained
measures.caveat: The threshold is a stated convention, not a validated one. A long gain is a long gain: this measure says nothing about coverage busts, missed assignments or scheme.

measures.label: Explosive rush rate (allowed, >=12 yds)
measures.definition: share of rush plays gaining at least 12 yards, grouped by the team's defence. A yardage threshold and nothing more.
measures.denominator: rush plays with a recorded yards_gained
measures.caveat: The threshold is a stated convention, not a validated one. A long gain is a long gain: this measure says nothing about coverage busts, missed assignments or scheme.

measures.label: Sack rate taken per dropback
measures.definition: sacks taken divided by dropbacks, where a dropback is any pass-typed play plus sacks
measures.caveat: A sack rate is not a pressure rate. CFBD types QB scrambles as Rush and the play text that would separate them is dropped at ingest, so the denominator understates true dropbacks by the scramble count.

measures.label: Sack rate generated per opponent dropback
measures.definition: sacks generated divided by opponent dropbacks
measures.caveat: A sack rate is not a pressure rate. Same scramble caveat as the offensive measure.

measures.label: Rush stuff rate suffered (proxy)
measures.definition: share of the team's rushes gaining zero or fewer yards
measures.caveat: Proxy. CFBD's canonical stuffRate lives on /stats/game/advanced, which this repo has no loader and no cache for.

measures.label: Rush stuff rate generated (proxy)
measures.definition: share of opponent rushes held to zero or fewer yards
measures.caveat: Proxy. See the offensive measure.

measures.label: Short-yardage conversion rate
measures.definition: on 3rd or 4th down with 2 or fewer yards to go, share of plays gaining the distance

measures.label: Short-yardage conversion rate allowed
measures.definition: opponent conversion rate on 3rd/4th and 2 or fewer

measures.label: Interceptions thrown
measures.definition: count of Interception, Pass Interception Return and Interception Return Touchdown plays with the team on offence

measures.label: Interception rate per dropback
measures.definition: interceptions thrown divided by dropbacks

measures.label: Interceptions forced
measures.definition: same three play types with the team on defence

measures.label: Interception rate forced per opponent dropback
measures.definition: interceptions forced divided by opponent dropbacks

measures.label: Fumbles (all outcomes)
measures.definition: count of Fumble Recovery (Own), Fumble Recovery (Opponent) and Fumble Return Touchdown plays with the team on offence — the real denominator for a recovery rate

measures.label: Fumbles lost
measures.definition: fumbles recovered by the opponent, including fumble return touchdowns

measures.label: Fumble retention rate
measures.definition: own recoveries divided by all own fumbles — the component that separates fumbling from fumble luck

measures.label: Fumble rate per offensive play
measures.definition: all fumbles divided by offensive plays

measures.label: Fumbles forced
measures.definition: the same three play types with the team on defence

measures.label: Opponent-fumble recovery share
measures.definition: share of opponent fumbles this defence recovered

measures.label: Takeaway rate per opponent play
measures.definition: interceptions forced plus opponent fumbles recovered, divided by opponent plays

measures.label: Giveaway rate per play
measures.definition: interceptions thrown plus fumbles lost, divided by offensive plays

measures.label: Offensive plays per game
measures.definition: mean non-garbage-time offensive plays per completed game

measures.label: Opponent plays per game faced
measures.definition: mean non-garbage-time opponent plays per completed game

measures.label: Seconds per play
measures.definition: BLOCKED
measures.blocked_reason: The play clock is not in the cache: ingest.normalize_plays drops CFBD's clock field, and normalize_drives drops elapsed/startTime/endTime. Both exist upstream. Re-fetching into the existing parquet paths would break the input hashes of the selected benchmark.

measures.label: Time-of-possession share
measures.definition: BLOCKED
measures.blocked_reason: Same missing clock fields as seconds_per_play. CFBD serves possessionTime on /games/teams, for which this repo has no loader and no cache.

measures.label: Drives per game
measures.definition: mean regulation drives per completed game
measures.blocked_reason: cfbd_drives is NOT declared in data/context_sources.json, and that manifest is the only place a source may be declared, so the layer refuses to read it. The drives cache is already a production input (nflvalue/data_health.py INPUTS, nflvalue/cfb_sim.py) and needs no new dependency, no cost and no extra CFBD call -- the parquet already exists. UNBLOCK: declare cfbd_drives in data/context_sources.json with an approval record (named approver, date, decision record) and a loader of nflvalue.ingest.load_drives, then add a matching FieldSpec + provider in nflvalue/context/ so the context layer's own contract test still holds. That single decision unblocks drives_per_game, points_per_drive_off, points_per_drive_def and avg_start_yards_to_goal_off.

measures.label: Field-goal attempts
measures.definition: Field Goal Good + Field Goal Missed + Blocked Field Goal with the team on offence

measures.label: Field-goal make rate
measures.definition: Field Goal Good divided by all field-goal attempts

measures.label: Field-goal attempt distance, median
measures.definition: median of (yards_to_goal + 17) over field-goal attempts — a robust summary, because a single 58-yard try moves a mean and not a median

measures.label: Field-goal attempt distance, interquartile range
measures.definition: 75th minus 25th percentile of attempt distance

measures.label: Field-goal make rate, 40+ yards
measures.definition: make rate restricted to attempts of 40 yards or longer

measures.label: Punts
measures.definition: Punt-typed plays with the team on offence (the punting team)

measures.label: Kick-block rate allowed
measures.definition: Blocked Field Goal plus Blocked Punt divided by field-goal attempts plus punts

measures.label: Field-goal attempts and makes by distance bucket
measures.definition: attempt and make counts in <30, 30-39, 40-49, 50+ buckets — the opportunity counts behind the rates

measures.label: Punt-return TDs allowed per punt
measures.definition: Punt Return Touchdown plays with the team on offence (i.e. punting), divided by punts

measures.label: Kick-return TDs allowed per kickoff
measures.definition: Kickoff Return Touchdown with the team on offence (i.e. kicking), divided by kickoffs

measures.label: Return yards allowed per return
measures.definition: BLOCKED
measures.blocked_reason: Field semantics unverified. yards_gained on special-teams rows is not the return distance: a Punt row reads 0 and a Punt Return Touchdown reads 22 on a play that plainly gained far more. CFBD's canonical puntReturnYards/kickReturnYards live on /games/teams, for which this repo has no loader and no cache.

measures.label: Punt-return TDs scored per punt faced
measures.definition: Punt Return Touchdown with the team on defence (i.e. returning), divided by punts faced

measures.label: Kick-return TDs scored per kickoff faced
measures.definition: Kickoff Return Touchdown with the team on defence (i.e. returning), divided by kickoffs faced

measures.label: Return yards per return
measures.definition: BLOCKED
measures.blocked_reason: Same unverified yards_gained semantics as coverage_yards_allowed_per_return.

measures.label: Rush offence efficiency (opponent-adjusted)
measures.definition: the EXISTING hierarchical-ridge unit rating from ratings.solve_units, fitted on strictly earlier games only. Defence ratings are sign-flipped upstream so higher is better everywhere.
measures.opponent_adjustment_method: ratings.solve_units (hierarchical weighted ridge; opponent term is a column in the design matrix)
measures.caveat: Opponent strength is already inside this number. Do not add a second strength-of-schedule term beside it, and do not combine it with the raw unadjusted measures as if they were independent.

measures.label: Quarterback availability
measures.definition: verified starter availability with citation, publication time and status confidence
measures.blocked_reason: qb_availability_feed approval status is not_requested in data/context_sources.json. An unapproved source cannot emit a value. Absence of a report is UNKNOWN, never healthy.

measures.label: Unit availability (non-QB)
measures.definition: verified unit-level availability with citations
measures.blocked_reason: unit_availability_feed approval status is not_requested. Absence of a report is UNKNOWN.

measures.label: Verified roster changes
measures.definition: transfer-portal and roster movement with citations
measures.blocked_reason: cfbd_portal approval status is not_requested and it has no loader or cache.
